name: Leads Directory Full CRUD & Conversion Lifecycle
description: Verify lead creation, form validations, search filtering, and conversion into Customer and Opportunity

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login, sign in with email 'admin@flowcrm.local' and password 'FlowAdmin123!', and navigate to /leads
Verify the Leads table loads with company names, status badges, and the 'New Lead' button
Click the 'New Lead' button to open the lead creation form
Fill First Name 'Captain', Last Name 'Tarek', Company Name 'Apex Fitness Club', Email 'tarek@apexfit.example', Phone '+201009988776', and Estimated Value '50000'
Click 'Create Lead' button to submit the form
Assert redirected to lead details page with company name 'Apex Fitness Club', status badge, and action buttons
Click 'Convert' button to convert the lead into a customer and deal
Assert lead conversion completes and redirects to the Customer 360 page
